data.name: DisclaimerIntro
data.value: CardTradeBuddy is a tool that helps collectors identify trading cards and estimate their value. Please read this notice carefully. You must accept it in order to create a user.

data.name: DisclaimerP1
data.value: Card details, prices and estimates presented on this site are obtained from third-party sources and from automated recognition of photographs. They may be incomplete, outdated or incorrect. The service may misidentify a card, its set, its language or its finish (normal, holofoil or reverse holofoil).

data.name: DisclaimerP2
data.value: All prices are indicative only. The actual market value of a card depends on its condition, language, edition, grading, the marketplace and the time. Nothing on this site constitutes an appraisal, an offer to buy or sell, or financial advice.

data.name: DisclaimerP3
data.value: Before you buy, sell or trade a card, verify the card details and the price against several independent sources, such as established marketplaces and price guides, and against the card itself. You are solely responsible for your decisions.

data.name: CookiesIntro
data.value: Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser. CardTradeBuddy uses only the cookies it needs to work. We do not use advertising, tracking or analytics cookies, and we do not share cookie data with advertisers.

data.name: CookiesAllNecessary
data.value: All of these cookies are strictly necessary for the site to work, which is why you cannot decline them. You are asked to accept them once, and your acceptance is remembered in the cookie cardtradebuddy.consent.

data.name: CookiesOthersText
data.value: The check that you are a person on the forms comes from Cloudflare (Turnstile), which may set a security cookie while it runs. Card pictures and set logos are loaded straight from the card list’s servers (tcgdex.net): your browser contacts them, so they receive your IP address and browser details like any website you visit. We do not control the cookies these companies may set.

data.name: CookiesManageText
data.value: You can delete cookies in your browser’s settings at any time. If you do, you will be logged out and asked to accept the cookies again. If you block them, the site cannot work.

data.name: CookiesChangesText
data.value: If we ever add cookies that are not strictly necessary, we will ask for your choice before they are set, and update this page.
